name: dsh-archived-session-delete
description: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for the Settings dialog: the Archived sessions page gains a permanent Delete action per row, and orphan sessions (on-disk session directories referenced by no workspace and not archived) can be scanned and deleted too. Deletion matches the clean-dsh-sessions skill: the session data directory, its session_projcache record, and its index entries are all removed. Runs on Windows, macOS and Linux — the host half uses node:fs directly, so it needs no PowerShell, no shell and no platform-specific command.
